title: Queries: Save and Reuse Search and Database Queries | Orchard Core
description:
A site asks the same questions again and again: the posts of a blog, a search, a count from the database. When that query text is copied into every template, script and controller, each change is a hunt for copies.

The Queries module saves a query under a name, with a source that decides how it runs. You run it by name from Liquid, Razor, scripts and the API, move it with recipes and deployment plans, and add a source of your own.

In this video:
• Why saved queries, and the features that provide them
• The Queries screen: Search, Queries, All Queries
• Creating a query
• Running a query by name, and the permissions it needs
• The Queries recipe step and the deployment steps
• Adding a query source: a source class, a display driver, a Link view and a handler
